name: nfsservctl
synopsis: long nfsservctl(int cmd, struct nfsctl_arg *argp, union nfsctl_res *resp);
description: nfsservctl is a system call that provides an interface to the kernel NFS daemon for operations such as adding or removing clients and exporting filesystems. It uses commands and arguments to perform these tasks. However, it has been removed since Linux 3.1 and replaced by files in the nfsd filesystem.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Command to execute, such as NFSCTL_SVC for server process or NFSCTL_ADDCLIENT for adding a client.

parameters.name: argp
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure containing arguments specific to the command.

parameters.name: resp
parameters.description: Pointer to a union for storing results of the command, if applicable.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

versions: Removed in Linux 3.1; removed in glibc 2.28
